nodes.label: Backlit View Warning (checks.mjs)
nodes.rationale: Foam, spray and pale features vanish against low-sun glare; check them front-lit (sunAzimuthDeg 160) first.

nodes.label: Rocks in the Sea (waterRocks, waveOnRock, nearest 48)
nodes.norm_label: rocks in the sea (waterrocks, waveonrock, nearest 48)

nodes.label: Leaf Meshes per Species and Bark Relief
nodes.norm_label: leaf meshes per species and bark relief

nodes.label: Goal: Realistic and Cheap to Render
nodes.norm_label: goal: realistic and cheap to render
nodes.rationale: Every feature should look like a photograph of a real coast and cost as little as possible; research over 'looks cool'; spend detail where the camera sees it; a feature adding >10% render time needs a reason.

nodes.label: Per-mesh ~100k Triangle Budget
nodes.rationale: Species are instanced hundreds of times; keep each mesh under ~100k triangles (tested).

nodes.label: Task Rule Overridden by Research (half-height breaking → McCowan)
nodes.norm_label: task rule overridden by research (half-height breaking → mccowan)
nodes.rationale: The task's 'breaks when ground reaches half its height' rule isn't what measurements say, so McCowan/Weggel was used.

nodes.label: Auto Exposure, AgX Tone Mapping, Bloom
nodes.norm_label: auto exposure, agx tone mapping, bloom

nodes.label: Frame Accumulation (64-frame Averaging)
nodes.rationale: Stochastic clouds converge; also replaced takram cloud TAA history.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages CI with Daily latest.jpg
nodes.norm_label: github pages ci with daily latest.jpg

nodes.label: Decision: Clouds at Full Resolution on Beaches
nodes.norm_label: decision: clouds at full resolution on beaches
nodes.rationale: Half-res clouds upsampled across silhouettes gave glowing rims; depth-aware upsampling can't recover thin twigs. Cost ~5 → ~9 s for a cloudy 4K beach.

nodes.label: Decision: Procedural Props, No Downloaded Models
nodes.norm_label: decision: procedural props, no downloaded models
nodes.rationale: Zero asset weight and per-date variety.

nodes.label: Sunset Tree Glow Fix (four causes)
nodes.rationale: Cloud TAA smear, half-res cloud upsampling, MSAA edge sky, GGX glints on leaves; found by switching passes off one at a time.

nodes.label: Decision: Web-only Rendering
nodes.rationale: Static Pages site; each visitor's browser renders the day; a still can afford seconds. Rejected Blender/Cycles headless and paid AI image generation.

nodes.label: Horizon ~4.5 km from 1.6 m Eye Height
nodes.norm_label: horizon ~4.5 km from 1.6 m eye height

nodes.label: --props Placement Report and --crop
nodes.rationale: Answers 'did it show up and where' without reading an image; replaces temporary console.warn logs.

nodes.label: Seals, Sea Lions, Fur and Elephant Seals by Coast
nodes.norm_label: seals, sea lions, fur and elephant seals by coast

nodes.label: Three Render Rounds per Feature Budget
nodes.norm_label: three render rounds per feature budget
nodes.rationale: See it, fix all, confirm; reason from numbers or --props instead of a fourth round.

nodes.label: ctx.inFrame() vs ctx.visible()
nodes.rationale: visible() only says a sphere touches the frustum, so features ended at frame edges; inFrame() keeps NDC inside the central 75–85%.

nodes.label: allParams() Date Listing via Throwaway Vitest
nodes.norm_label: allparams() date listing via throwaway vitest
nodes.rationale: Computing params is cheap (three years in ~1 s), rendering is not.

nodes.label: Scene Spec JSON (sceneSpec.ts)
nodes.rationale: Force whatever a feature needs instead of hunting for dates; unforced spec stays byte-identical to the date; unknown fields throw so a typo never renders a random day.

nodes.label: Date as Seed (date → SceneParams)
nodes.rationale: Same day, same scene everywhere; any date can be re-rendered, so the archive is free.

nodes.label: Independent Random Streams per Feature
nodes.rationale: ctx.rng('feature') / Random.derive(seed,'feature'); never add draws to the main rng in generateParams since that changes every other day's scene.

nodes.label: Split Choice from Geometry Pattern (xxxFor / geometry / createXxx)
nodes.norm_label: split choice from geometry pattern (xxxfor / geometry / createxxx)
nodes.rationale: Pure choice functions and mesh builders are unit-testable without WebGL.

nodes.label: PropContext.seaLevel() CPU Wave Sampling
nodes.rationale: Anything at mean sea level is hidden by crests at grazing angles; place on seaLevel() and lift a little.

nodes.label: Surf Physics (Shoaling, McCowan/Weggel Breaking)
nodes.rationale: Green's law shoaling below L/2; break at H = γ·d with γ = 0.72 + 5.6 × slope; zero-mean profile; face never narrower than 2.5 grid cells to avoid zig-zag.

nodes.label: Splash Screen Boat Riding Parabolic Waves
nodes.norm_label: splash screen boat riding parabolic waves

nodes.label: Sea Sunset Favicon
nodes.rationale: 64x64 rounded-square app icon depicting a sun setting over layered ocean waves; a miniature emblem of the sea wallpaper scene

nodes.label: Layered Ocean Waves
nodes.rationale: Two quadratic-curve wave paths (lighter front-back depth layering) suggest ocean depth

nodes.label: Turbulence Noise Texture (turbulence.png)
nodes.description: Small tileable RGB noise texture (about 128x128) with independent, blotchy multi-octave noise in each color channel. It produces saturated rainbow patches.
nodes.rationale: A packed multi-channel noise lookup lets a shader sample several decorrelated noise values (for example UV distortion offsets) in one texture fetch, so it does not have to compute procedural noise per pixel.

nodes.label: Water Turbulence / UV Distortion
nodes.rationale: The file name and look suggest it is sampled to perturb texture coordinates for water surfaces, refraction or caustics in the sea wallpaper scene.

nodes.label: SwiftShader software WebGL on CI
nodes.rationale: Runners have no GPU, so snapshots use software WebGL with fewer cloud frames (24); step is continue-on-error so the site still deploys without a fresh latest.jpg.
